description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing facility. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader dedicated to upholding the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence. Join a team committed to making a significant impact on the lives of residents and staff.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements and fostering a positive, supportive environment. This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to drive significant improvements in a dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Strong financial acumen and operational management skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
